security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives from Markdown fences and JavaScript template literals, not shell execution. The real risks are example network calls to configured services and a CI workflow that runs production migrations on push. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Network examples post to configurable service endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Document trusted endpoints, TLS, authentication, timeouts, and response checks for Kafka Connect, Grafana, and Slack calls.

remediation.issue: The CI example runs a production migration on pushes to main.
remediation.suggestion: Add manual approval, staging validation, backups, rollback checks, and protected environments before production migration execution.

remediation.issue: Operational tokens and webhooks are referenced through generic configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to load tokens and webhooks from secret managers and never log or echo those values.

content.user_title: Monitor Database Migrations in Real Time
content.value_statement: Database migrations can fail silently when CDC, lag, and alerts are not visible. This skill helps teams design metrics, dashboards, and alerts for safer migration monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Creates observable MongoDB migration patterns with duration, document, and error metrics.
Outlines CDC monitoring with Kafka, Debezium connector setup, and replication lag metrics.
Defines Prometheus counters, gauges, histograms, and anomaly checks for migration health.
Builds Grafana dashboard structures for progress, lag, and error-rate views.
Shows alerting flows for Slack, email, and migration anomaly notifications.
Provides CI workflow examples for starting monitors and checking migration health.
limitations: It is a guidance skill, not a ready-to-run monitoring package.
Examples need environment-specific dependencies, credentials, and network policies.
It does not validate production safety, backups, or rollback plans for users.
Security hardening for Kafka Connect, Grafana, and webhooks must be added by the team.

use_cases.title: Plan Migration Observability
use_cases.description: Design the metrics, alerts, and dashboards needed before a major database migration starts.

use_cases.title: Track CDC Pipeline Health
use_cases.description: Create monitoring for Debezium events, Kafka consumer lag, and source-to-target replication delay.

use_cases.title: Review Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Check whether migration monitoring includes health checks, anomaly alerts, and CI validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Define Basic Metrics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a single migration service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define basic Prometheus metrics for a database migration. Include duration, rows processed, errors, and lag.

prompt_templates.title: Create CDC Monitoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Design CDC monitoring for PostgreSQL with Debezium and Kafka. Include lag, event volume, failure alerts, and dashboard panels.

prompt_templates.title: Build Alert Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Create alerting rules for a production migration. Cover throughput drops, high error rate, replication lag, and stalled consumers.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Migration Observability
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my migration observability plan for gaps. Assess metrics, dashboards, alerts, CI checks, rollback signals, and security controls.

output_examples.input: I need monitoring for a MongoDB migration.
output: A metrics plan covering duration, documents processed, and errors.
A transaction-aware migration flow that records success and failure status.
Dashboard ideas for progress, throughput, and recent failures.

output_examples.input: We use Debezium and Kafka for CDC during migration.
output: A CDC monitoring design for event volume, consumer lag, and replication delay.
Connector setup guidance with operational metrics to verify pipeline health.
Alert thresholds for stalled consumers and delayed target updates.

output_examples.input: Review our migration release monitoring before launch.
output: A readiness checklist for metrics, dashboards, alerts, and health checks.
Identified gaps in approval gates, rollback visibility, and secret handling.
Recommended changes before running production migration jobs.

best_practices: Define success, lag, throughput, and error metrics before the migration starts.
Use protected secrets, trusted endpoints, and TLS for monitoring integrations.
Test dashboards, alerts, and rollback signals in staging before production runs.
anti_patterns: Running production migrations from CI without approval gates or rollback checks.
Sending alerts or dashboard updates to untrusted webhook or Grafana endpoints.
Treating example thresholds as final values without workload-specific validation.

faq.question: Does this skill run migrations for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides observability patterns and examples that teams adapt to their own migration tools.

faq.question: Which monitoring tools does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, Kafka and Debezium CDC monitoring, and alerting integrations.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Is the generated code production ready?
faq.answer: No. Treat the examples as patterns and add authentication, testing, approvals, and rollback controls.

faq.question: Does it include security hardening?
faq.answer: It mentions configuration and secrets, but teams must add full security controls for their environment.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare migration goals, source and target systems, monitoring stack details, alert channels, and safety requirements.
